run_release_docs: run the release_docs.py script with a version number to branch Google Test/Mock wiki pages for a new release
run_WikiBrancher_init: run WikiBrancher with a dot version string to set up version prefix and collect files to branch
run_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: run BranchFiles on a WikiBrancher instance to svn copy wiki files with a version prefix
run_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranchedFi: run UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to update internal wiki links in versioned branched files to point to the new versioned pages
run_DropWikiSuffix: run DropWikiSuffix on a wiki filename to remove the .wiki suffix if present
